Committed as `ae41aa22c`. The commit picked up a few extra staged files from the pre-existing index (overdue command files), but the MCP resources change is included.

Here's what was added to `operations/engineering/fars/mcp-servers/datastore/server.js`:

**7 MCP Resources:**
- `entity://term/{name}` — browse term definitions (library graph)
- `entity://text/{name}` — browse texts/papers/essays (library graph)
- `entity://plan/{name}` — browse plans (ops graph)
- `entity://task/{name}` — browse tasks (ops graph)
- `entity://event/{name}` — browse events (ops graph)
- `entity://session/{name}` — browse agent sessions (ops graph)
- `entity://id/{eid}` — access any entity by numeric ID (both graphs)

Each resource template includes:
- **list** callback — enumerates all entities of that type
- **complete** callback — autocomplete for the `name`/`eid` variable
- **read** callback — returns the actual file content (if the entity has a `path`) or a markdown rendering of graph attributes
- Metadata with `description` and `mimeType: "text/markdown"`
